opts: Exercise helps the body but harms the brain.
Only the brain, not the body, benefits from exercise.
Memory and concentration are unaffected by exercise.
Besides helping the body, regular exercise also sharpens memory and concentration.
restate.tr: 'benefits not only the body but also the brain, improving memory' = sadece beden değil beyin de yarar görür; doğru cevap iki yararı korur.
restate.en: 'helps the body and also the brain' keeps both benefits.

restate.stem: Mass tourism brings welcome income to many towns, yet it can also raise local prices and strain the very landscapes that attract visitors in the first place.
opts: Mass tourism provides income but may push up prices and damage the landscapes that drew tourists.
Mass tourism only ever harms the towns it reaches.
Tourism lowers local prices and protects the landscape.
Towns gain nothing at all from mass tourism.
restate.tr: 'brings welcome income ... yet can raise prices and strain the landscapes' = gelir getirir ama fiyatları ve doğayı zorlar; doğru cevap iki yönü korur.
restate.en: 'income, yet higher prices and strained landscapes' keeps both sides.

restate.stem: New gene-editing tools could one day cure inherited diseases, though many scientists urge caution until the long-term effects are properly understood.
opts: Gene-editing tools have already cured all inherited diseases.

Scientists agree that gene editing is completely safe to use now.
Gene editing can never affect inherited diseases.
restate.tr: 'could one day cure ... though scientists urge caution until long-term effects understood' = ileride tedavi edebilir ama uzun vadeli etkiler bilinene dek dikkat; doğru cevap bunu korur.
restate.en: 'might cure, but caution until long-term effects clear' keeps the caveat.

restate.stem: Cheap, fashionable clothes are tempting to buy, but producing them quickly and in huge amounts creates serious environmental problems.
opts: Cheap fashionable clothes have no effect on the environment.
Producing clothes slowly causes the most pollution.
Although such clothes are tempting, making them fast and in vast quantities causes serious environmental harm.
Expensive clothes are the main cause of environmental damage.
restate.tr: 'tempting to buy, but producing them quickly and in huge amounts creates problems' = cazip ama hızlı/çok üretim çevreye zarar; doğru cevap iki yönü korur.
restate.en: 'tempting, but fast mass production harms the environment' keeps both.

restate.stem: Decades of launches have left so much debris in orbit that even a tiny fragment, travelling at enormous speed, can destroy a working satellite.
opts: Orbital debris is harmless because the pieces are small.
Only large objects in orbit threaten satellites.
Satellites are never at risk from orbital debris.
Years of launches have filled orbit with debris, and even a small piece moving very fast can wreck a functioning satellite.
restate.tr: 'so much debris ... even a tiny fragment at enormous speed can destroy a satellite' = küçük parça bile yüksek hızda uyduyu yok edebilir; doğru cevap bunu korur.

restate.stem: Historians treat every document with caution, aware that its author may have had reasons to emphasise certain facts and quietly omit others.
opts: Historians read each document carefully, knowing the writer might have stressed some facts and left others out.
Historians accept every document as a complete and neutral record.
Documents written at the time are always free of bias.
Historians ignore documents because they cannot be trusted at all.
restate.tr: 'treat every document with caution ... author may emphasise some facts and omit others' = her belgeyi temkinle okur; doğru cevap bu kuşkuyu korur.
restate.en: 'read each document with caution about emphasis and omission' keeps the skepticism.

restate.stem: Some damaged reefs can recover if given enough time, but the heatwaves that harm them are now arriving too frequently for that recovery to take place.
opts: Damaged reefs always recover, no matter how often heatwaves occur.
Reefs could recover with time, yet heatwaves now strike too often to allow it.
Heatwaves help reefs recover more quickly.
Reefs never recover from any damage.
restate.tr: 'can recover if given time, but heatwaves arriving too frequently for recovery' = zaman olsa toparlanır ama şoklar çok sık; doğru cevap bunu korur.
restate.en: 'could recover with time, but heatwaves too frequent' keeps the condition.

restate.stem: Doctors do not say that all screen time is harmful for children; they argue that what matters most is how the time is used and whether it replaces sleep and play.
opts: Doctors say every minute of screen time harms children.
Doctors claim screen time has no effect on children at all.
Doctors argue that the key issue is not screens themselves but how the time is used and what it displaces.
Doctors believe screens are always better than sleep and play.
restate.tr: 'do not say all screen time is harmful ... what matters is how it is used and whether it replaces sleep and play' = önemli olan kullanımı ve neyin yerini aldığı; doğru cevap nüansı korur.
restate.en: 'not all screen time is harmful; what matters is use and what it displaces' keeps the nuance.

restate.stem: High inflation hurts people who keep their money in cash, because the same amount buys a little less with each passing month.
opts: High inflation benefits those who hold cash.
Inflation has no effect on the value of cash.
Cash gains value steadily when inflation is high.
Holding cash during high inflation is costly, since its purchasing power falls month by month.
restate.tr: 'hurts people who keep money in cash ... buys a little less each month' = nakit tutanın alım gücü her ay azalır; doğru cevap bunu korur.
restate.en: 'cash loses purchasing power monthly under inflation' keeps the mechanism.

restate.stem: Although many remedies used by ancient healers had no real effect, a surprising number contained plants whose active ingredients modern medicine still relies on.
opts: While many old remedies did nothing, a striking number used plants whose active compounds modern medicine still uses.
Every remedy used by ancient healers was completely useless.
Ancient healers used only plants that modern medicine has rejected.
Modern medicine owes nothing to ancient plant remedies.
restate.tr: 'many had no effect, a surprising number contained plants modern medicine still relies on' = çoğu işe yaramazdı ama şaşırtıcı sayıda etken madde bugün de kullanılıyor; doğru cevap iki yönü korur.
restate.en: 'many did nothing, yet many used compounds still used today' keeps both.

restate.stem: People volunteer not only to help others but also because the work gives them a sense of purpose and a chance to meet new friends.
opts: People volunteer purely to help others, with no personal benefit.
People volunteer both to help others and because it gives them purpose and new friendships.
Volunteering offers no benefit to the volunteer at all.
People volunteer mainly to avoid meeting new people.
restate.tr: 'not only to help others but also because it gives purpose and a chance to meet friends' = hem başkasına yardım hem amaç/arkadaşlık; doğru cevap iki güdüyü korur.

restate.stem: A large dam can supply clean electricity to millions, yet building it often floods valleys and forces whole communities to leave their homes.
opts: Large dams produce electricity without affecting anyone.
Dams only harm the environment and never produce useful power.
A big dam can give clean power to millions but may flood valleys and displace entire communities.
Communities are never affected by the building of dams.
restate.tr: 'can supply clean electricity ... yet building it floods valleys and forces communities to leave' = temiz enerji verir ama vadileri sular ve toplulukları göçe zorlar; doğru cevap iki yönü korur.
restate.en: 'clean power, yet flooding and displacement' keeps both sides.

restate.stem: A skilled reader does not simply accept what a text says; they ask who wrote it, why, and what evidence supports its claims.
opts: A skilled reader accepts every statement in a text without question.
Skilled readers care only about who wrote a text, not its evidence.
Reading critically means ignoring the author entirely.
Good readers go beyond accepting a text, questioning its author, purpose, and evidence.
restate.tr: 'does not simply accept ... asks who wrote it, why, and what evidence supports' = yazarı, amacı ve kanıtı sorgular; doğru cevap eleştirel okuma tanımını korur.
restate.en: 'questions author, purpose, and evidence' keeps the definition of critical reading.

restate.stem: If bee populations keep falling, the cost of many fruits and vegetables is likely to rise, since these crops depend on insects to pollinate them.
opts: Should bee numbers keep dropping, prices of many crops may climb because those crops rely on insect pollination.
Falling bee numbers will make fruit and vegetables cheaper.
Fruits and vegetables do not need bees at all.
Bee numbers have no link to the price of crops.
restate.tr: 'if bee populations keep falling, cost likely to rise, since crops depend on insects' = arı azalırsa ürün pahalanır çünkü tozlaşmaya bağımlı; doğru cevap neden-sonucu korur.
restate.en: 'fewer bees, higher crop prices because crops need pollination' keeps the causal chain.

sentences: Many early printers, however, complained that the quality of locally produced paper was disappointingly poor.
The invention of the printing press in the fifteenth century made it possible to produce books far more quickly than by hand.
As a result, texts that had once been rare and expensive gradually became affordable to a much wider public.
This rapid spread of printed material helped ideas to circulate across borders with unprecedented speed.
Within a few generations, literacy rates began to rise in regions where printing had taken hold.
oddout.tr: Paragraf matbaanın fikirleri yayması ve okuryazarlığı artırmasını anlatır; kâğıt kalitesinden şikâyet eden cümle yan bir ayrıntı olup anlam bütünlüğünü bozar.
oddout.en: The paragraph is about printing spreading ideas and literacy; the sentence complaining about poor paper quality is a side detail that breaks the unity.

sentences: Plants use sunlight to turn water and carbon dioxide into the sugars they need to grow.
Some gardeners prefer to plant their vegetables in neat, straight rows.
This process, called photosynthesis, takes place mainly in the green parts of the plant.
In doing so, plants release oxygen, which most living things depend on to breathe.
Without photosynthesis, life as we know it on Earth could not exist.
oddout.tr: Paragraf fotosentezi ve önemini açıklar; bahçıvanların düzgün sıralar tercih etmesini anlatan cümle konuyla ilgisizdir.
oddout.en: The paragraph explains photosynthesis and its importance; the sentence about gardeners preferring neat rows is irrelevant.

sentences: Many teenagers find it difficult to fall asleep early, partly because of natural changes in their body clock.
Yet most schools still begin classes at a time that suits younger children far better.
Football remains one of the most popular sports among students of this age.
As a result, a large number of adolescents arrive at school without having had enough sleep.
Researchers say this lack of rest can affect both their mood and their ability to concentrate.
oddout.tr: Paragraf ergenlerde uyku eksikliği ve sonuçlarını ele alır; futbolun popülerliğinden söz eden cümle bağlam dışıdır.
oddout.en: The paragraph is about teenage sleep deprivation and its effects; the sentence about football's popularity is off-topic.

sentences: The Romans built an extensive network of roads to move their armies quickly across the empire.
These roads were carefully engineered, with solid foundations and drainage that allowed them to last for centuries.
Merchants soon took advantage of them, and trade flourished along the same routes the legions used.
Modern tourists today often prefer to travel by high-speed train rather than by car.
Long after the empire fell, many of these roads continued to shape the movement of people and goods.

lines.t: Our proposal was technically excellent, yet the committee still rejected it.
You may be right. Perhaps we failed to show how the findings would benefit the wider public.

opts: Maybe the problem wasn't the quality of the work but how well we explained its relevance.
I suppose the science simply wasn't strong enough, then.
Then we should submit exactly the same proposal again next year.
It clearly means they never read the proposal at all.
dialogue.tr: A teknik mükemmellik olmasına rağmen reddi vurguluyor; sonrasında 'kamu yararını gösterememek'i kabul ediyor. B, kaliteyi değil anlatımı sorgulayarak bu akışa uyar.
dialogue.en: A stresses rejection despite technical excellence and then concedes they failed to show public relevance. B fits by questioning the framing, not the quality.

lines.t: Did you manage to see the new exhibition at the history museum?
I did, but honestly the labels were so long that I gave up reading them.
Exactly. A few clear sentences would have told me far more than those huge paragraphs.

opts: I agree the rooms were far too dark to see anything.
I know what you mean; sometimes too much information is worse than too little.
That's a shame, because the entrance fee was quite cheap.
So you think the museum should add even more detail to the labels?
dialogue.tr: B etiketlerin fazla uzun olmasından yakınır; sonraki replikte 'birkaç net cümle daha iyi olurdu' der. C, fazla bilginin azdan kötü olabileceğini söyleyerek köprü kurar.
dialogue.en: B complains the labels were too long and then says a few clear sentences would help more. C bridges this by noting too much information can be worse than too little.

lines.t: The trial showed improvement, but only in a very small number of patients.
That's exactly my concern. With so few cases, we can't rule out that it happened by chance.

opts: Then we can confidently recommend the treatment to everyone.
That proves the drug works better than any other on the market.
So the sample may simply be too small to draw any firm conclusion.
It means the patients must have been misdiagnosed from the start.
dialogue.tr: A çok az hastada iyileşmeyi belirtir; sonra 'şans eseri olabilir' kaygısını onaylar. B, örneklemin kesin sonuç için fazla küçük olduğunu söyleyerek uyumludur.
dialogue.en: A notes improvement in very few patients and then confirms a worry about chance. B fits by saying the sample may be too small for a firm conclusion.

lines.t: I always rinse the jars before putting them in the recycling bin.
Really? I had no idea that a little leftover food could ruin a whole batch.

opts: That's pointless; nobody checks whether the containers are clean.
You should stop recycling altogether to save time.
Glass jars can never be recycled, whatever you do with them.
It's a good habit, actually — dirty containers can contaminate everything else in the load.
dialogue.tr: A kavanozları yıkadığını söyler; sonra 'az artığın tüm partiyi bozabileceğini bilmediğini' belirtir. B bu bilgiyi vererek mantıklı köprü kurar.
dialogue.en: A says they rinse jars; A then admits surprise that leftover food could ruin a batch. B supplies that very information, making it the logical bridge.

lines.t: They said I was overqualified for the position. I'm not sure how to take that.
I hadn't thought of it that way. Maybe they assumed I'd leave as soon as something better came along.

opts: Sometimes employers worry that very experienced candidates will quickly become bored and move on.
It probably just means they didn't read your CV properly.
You should take it as a clear sign that you got the job.
Being overqualified always guarantees a higher salary.
dialogue.tr: A 'aşırı nitelikli' denmesine şaşırır; sonra 'daha iyisi çıkınca ayrılacağımı düşündüler' diye yorumlar. B tam bu kaygıyı dile getirerek akışı tamamlar.
dialogue.en: A is puzzled at being called overqualified and then reasons the employer feared they'd leave. B voices exactly that concern, completing the flow.

lines.t: Our teacher says we shouldn't trust a single source when studying the past.
Why not? If someone wrote it down at the time, surely it must be accurate.
I see — so even an eyewitness might describe events in a way that suits their own side.

opts: Yes, written records are always completely neutral.
Not necessarily; the person writing usually had their own interests and point of view.
That's true, which is why one source is always enough.
Then we should ignore written records entirely.
dialogue.tr: B 'aynı dönemde yazıldıysa doğrudur' der; sonra 'tanık bile kendi tarafına göre anlatabilir' diye anlar. A, yazanın kendi çıkarı olduğunu söyleyerek bu kavrayışı hazırlar.
dialogue.en: B claims a contemporary record must be accurate, then realises even a witness may be biased. A's reply about the writer's own interests sets up that realisation.

lines.t: Users keep complaining that the app is confusing, even though we added lots of new features.
You might be onto something. Maybe we should remove a few options rather than keep adding them.

opts: Then we clearly need to add even more features as quickly as possible.
It must mean the users simply aren't intelligent enough.
Perhaps all those extra features are precisely what's making it harder to use.
The app is obviously perfect, so the complaints can be ignored.
dialogue.tr: A özellik eklemeye rağmen kafa karışıklığından yakınır; sonra 'seçenek çıkaralım' der. B fazla özelliğin sorunun kaynağı olabileceğini söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A complains of confusion despite added features, then suggests removing options. B fits by proposing the extra features themselves cause the difficulty.

lines.t: I've cut out every kind of fat from my diet to lose weight.

opts: That's wise; the body has absolutely no use for fat of any kind.

Be careful, though — the body actually needs some fats to work properly.
dialogue.tr: A tüm yağları kestiğini söyler; sonra 'bazı yağlar iyi mi?' diye sorar. B, vücudun bazı yağlara ihtiyaç duyduğunu söyleyerek bu soruyu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A says they cut out all fat, then asks whether some fats are good. B sets that up by noting the body needs some fats.

lines.t: The headlines say unemployment is falling, so the economy must be doing well.

opts: Not so fast — the rate can also fall when discouraged people give up searching altogether.
Absolutely, a falling rate always tells the whole story.
It means wages must be rising for everyone right now.
Unemployment figures have no connection to the economy.
dialogue.tr: A düşen işsizliği iyi ekonomiye bağlar; sonra 'iş aramayı bırakanlar rakamı yanıltabilir' der. B tam bu nüansı sunarak akışı tamamlar.
dialogue.en: A links falling unemployment to a strong economy, then concedes discouraged workers can distort it. B introduces exactly that nuance.

lines.t: We found no gold or jewellery at the site, so the dig was basically a failure.

opts: I agree completely; without valuables, there's nothing worth studying.
I wouldn't say that — everyday objects often reveal far more about how people actually lived.
Then we should stop excavating the area immediately.
Gold is the only thing that ever matters in archaeology.
dialogue.tr: A değerli eşya bulunmadığı için kazıyı başarısız sayar; sonra 'kırık çömlek ve tohumlar günlük yaşamı daha iyi anlatır' der. B gündelik nesnelerin değerini vurgulayarak bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A calls the dig a failure for lack of valuables, then admits everyday finds reveal daily life better. B fits by stressing the value of ordinary objects.

lines.t: I signed up for three online courses this month, but I haven't finished a single one.

opts: Then you should sign up for several more straight away.
It clearly means online courses are a complete waste of time.
Perhaps you've simply taken on too many at once to give any of them proper attention.
You must be the only person who has ever struggled with this.
dialogue.tr: A üç kursa yazılıp hiçbirini bitiremediğini söyler; sonra 'birine odaklanmalıyım' der. B aynı anda çok fazlasını üstlenmeyi işaret ederek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A enrolled in three courses and finished none, then decides to focus on one. B sets this up by suggesting they took on too many at once.

lines.t: The patient insists the new tablets aren't working, even though the tests look fine.
Good thinking. I'll ask whether she's been taking them exactly as prescribed before we change anything.

opts: Then we should obviously double the dose right away.
The tests must be wrong, so we can ignore them.
She clearly needs a completely different diagnosis.
Before adjusting the medication, it might be worth checking how regularly she's actually taking it.
dialogue.tr: A testler iyi olsa da hastanın ilacın işe yaramadığını söylediğini belirtir; sonra 'reçeteye uyup uymadığını soracağım' der. B önce uyumu kontrol etmeyi önererek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A notes the patient says the tablets fail though tests are fine, then decides to check adherence. B fits by proposing to check how regularly she takes them first.

lines.t: The reviewers liked our method but said the sample was too small to prove anything.
You're right. If we run the study again with more participants, the results will carry far more weight.

opts: So perhaps the answer is to repeat the work on a larger group before we draw conclusions.
Then there's nothing we can do but give up the project.
That means our method must have been completely wrong.
I suppose the reviewers simply didn't read the proposal.
dialogue.tr: A küçük örneklem eleştirisini aktarır; sonra 'daha çok katılımcıyla tekrar' fikrini onaylar. Doğru replik, sonuca varmadan çalışmayı daha büyük grupta tekrarlamayı önererek bu akışı hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A reports the small-sample criticism, then agrees to repeat with more participants; the correct line proposes exactly that, fitting the flow.

lines.t: The patient says the new diet hasn't lowered her blood pressure at all.
Good point. I'll check how closely she's actually been following it before we change the plan.

opts: Then the diet clearly doesn't work and we should stop it.
Before we conclude that, it might be worth finding out how strictly she's keeping to it.
Her blood pressure must be impossible to treat.
We should double her medication immediately.
dialogue.tr: A diyetin tansiyonu düşürmediğini söyler; sonra 'ne kadar uyduğunu kontrol edeceğim' der. Doğru replik, sonuca varmadan uyumu kontrol etmeyi önererek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A says the diet hasn't helped, then decides to check adherence; the correct line proposes checking how strictly she follows it.

lines.t: Residents keep complaining about traffic, even though we've widened two of the main roads.
That hadn't occurred to me. Maybe bigger roads just encourage more people to drive.

opts: Then we should widen every road in the city as fast as possible.
It clearly means the residents are exaggerating.
Perhaps wider roads are part of the problem, not the solution.
Traffic has nothing to do with the width of roads.
dialogue.tr: A yolları genişletmesine rağmen şikâyetlerden yakınır; sonra 'büyük yollar daha çok araç çekebilir' der. Doğru replik, geniş yolların sorunun parçası olabileceğini söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A complains despite widening roads, then realises bigger roads invite more cars; the correct line suggests wider roads are part of the problem.

lines.t: I found a great website for my history project, so I'm just going to use that.
Be careful — anyone can put information online, true or not.
Exactly. If two or three reliable sources agree, you can trust the fact much more.

opts: So you think one website is always enough for a project.
Then I shouldn't use the internet for research at all.
That means all websites are completely accurate.
I see — so I should check the same facts in other sources too.
dialogue.tr: B internetteki bilginin doğru olmayabileceğini söyler; sonra 'birkaç güvenilir kaynak aynı şeyi söylerse güvenebilirsin' der. Doğru replik, aynı bilgiyi başka kaynaklarda doğrulamayı önererek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: B warns online info may be false, then says agreement of several sources builds trust; the correct line proposes cross-checking in other sources.

lines.t: Do I really need to wear goggles? I'm only mixing two harmless liquids.
Fair enough. I suppose it's better to be safe even when nothing seems dangerous.

opts: Even safe-looking reactions can splash, so it's wise to protect your eyes anyway.
No, goggles are a waste of time in this lab.
You should never wear goggles when mixing liquids.
Goggles only matter when you work with fire.
dialogue.tr: A gözlüğe gerek olmadığını ima eder; sonra 'tehlikesiz görünse de güvende olmak iyi' der. Doğru replik, güvenli görünen tepkimelerin bile sıçrayabileceğini söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A doubts the need for goggles, then agrees safety is wise; the correct line notes even safe-looking reactions can splash.

lines.t: Investors love the idea, but they keep asking how we'll actually make money.
You're right. A brilliant product is no use if we can't explain how it pays for itself.

opts: Then we should stop talking to investors altogether.
Maybe the problem is that we've described the product but not a clear plan for revenue.
It means the idea itself must be worthless.
Investors never care about how a company earns money.
dialogue.tr: A yatırımcıların 'nasıl para kazanacaksınız' sorusunu aktarır; sonra 'ürün harika olsa da kendini nasıl ödediğini anlatmalıyız' der. Doğru replik, net gelir planının eksik olduğunu söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A reports investors asking about revenue, then admits a great product needs a clear way to pay for itself; the correct line points to a missing revenue plan.

lines.t: I've started skipping breakfast completely to lose weight faster.
Oh, I didn't know that. So eating something in the morning might actually help?

opts: Good idea; the body never needs food in the morning.
You should skip lunch and dinner too, then.
Be careful — for many people, skipping breakfast just leads to overeating later.
Breakfast has no effect on weight at all.
dialogue.tr: A kahvaltıyı atladığını söyler; sonra 'sabah bir şey yemek aslında işe yarar mı?' diye sorar. Doğru replik, kahvaltıyı atlamanın ileride aşırı yemeye yol açabileceğini söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A says they skip breakfast, then asks if eating in the morning helps; the correct line notes skipping breakfast often leads to later overeating.

lines.t: This vase has almost no decoration. The plain ones must be the least valuable.
Really? So a simple shape can tell historians more than a fancy one?

opts: Yes, only decorated objects are worth studying.
That's true; plain vases are always worthless.
Actually, plain everyday objects often tell us most about how ordinary people lived.
dialogue.tr: A süssüz vazoyu değersiz sanır; sonra 'basit şekil daha çok şey anlatabilir mi?' der. Doğru replik, sade gündelik nesnelerin sıradan yaşamı en iyi anlattığını söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A assumes plain vases are worthless, then asks if a simple shape reveals more; the correct line notes plain everyday objects often reveal most about ordinary life.

lines.t: The app crashes only on some phones, so I think it's just those users' fault.
You may be right. If it happens on a whole brand of phone, the problem is probably ours.

opts: I'd be careful — if it always fails on one type of phone, that points to our code, not the users.
Yes, it's definitely the users who are doing something wrong.
Then we should ignore those users completely.
Crashes never tell us anything about the software.
dialogue.tr: A çökmeleri kullanıcılara yükler; sonra 'tüm bir marka telefonda oluyorsa sorun bizde' der. Doğru replik, belirli bir telefon türünde sürekli çökmenin kodu işaret ettiğini söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A blames users, then concedes a whole phone brand failing points to their code; the correct line makes that very point.

lines.t: My electricity bill doubled this winter, but I haven't bought any new devices.
That makes sense. The heater has been on almost all day during the cold spell.

opts: Then the electricity company must be cheating you.
Heating usually uses far more power than gadgets, so the cold weather could explain it.
New devices are the only thing that raises a bill.
Your bill has nothing to do with the weather.
dialogue.tr: A faturanın iki katına çıktığını ama yeni cihaz almadığını söyler; sonra 'soğukta ısıtıcı sürekli açıktı' der. Doğru replik, ısıtmanın cihazlardan çok güç çektiğini söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A is puzzled by a doubled bill with no new devices, then notes the heater ran all day; the correct line explains heating uses far more power than gadgets.

lines.t: My thesis question covers the entire history of European trade. There's just so much to read.
You're probably right. Focusing on one port over fifty years would be much more manageable.

opts: Then you should add even more centuries to be safe.
It means you shouldn't write a thesis at all.
Perhaps the topic is simply too broad to handle in a single thesis.
A narrow topic is always a bad idea.
dialogue.tr: A tezinin tüm Avrupa ticaretini kapsadığını, çok okuma olduğunu söyler; sonra 'tek liman, elli yıl daha yönetilebilir' der. Doğru replik, konunun fazla geniş olduğunu söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A says the thesis covers all European trade, too much to read, then agrees to narrow it; the correct line notes the topic is too broad.

lines.t: The label says take this medicine with food, but I always forget and take it on an empty stomach.
I see. So eating first isn't just a suggestion; it actually protects my stomach.

opts: It doesn't matter at all when you take it.
You should never eat before taking medicine.
Labels are usually wrong, so just ignore them.
That instruction is there for a reason — food can stop the medicine upsetting your stomach.
dialogue.tr: A ilacı aç karnına aldığını söyler; sonra 'önce yemek midemi koruyor' der. Doğru replik, talimatın boşuna olmadığını, yemeğin mideyi koruduğunu söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A admits taking the medicine on an empty stomach, then realises eating protects the stomach; the correct line explains the instruction exists for that reason.

lines.t: This translation app is amazing. I'll just use it for the whole business contract.
Good point. For something legal, one wrong word could cause real trouble.

opts: I'd be careful — these apps still make subtle mistakes that matter a lot in a contract.
Yes, the app is perfect for legal documents.
Then you never need a human translator again.
Legal documents are the easiest thing to translate.
dialogue.tr: A çeviri uygulamasını sözleşme için kullanmak ister; sonra 'hukuki metinde tek yanlış kelime sorun olur' der. Doğru replik, uygulamaların sözleşmede önemli ince hatalar yaptığını söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A wants to use the app for a contract, then notes one wrong legal word is risky; the correct line warns apps still make subtle, costly mistakes.

lines.t: I signed up for five different volunteer groups, but I never seem to actually help any of them.
You're right. I should probably commit to just one and give it my full attention.

opts: Then you should join several more groups at once.
Maybe you've simply taken on too many to give any of them real time.
It means volunteering is a waste of effort.
Helping one group is exactly the same as helping five.
dialogue.tr: A beş gruba yazılıp hiçbirine yardım edemediğini söyler; sonra 'birine tam odaklanmalıyım' der. Doğru replik, aynı anda çok fazlasını üstlendiğini söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A joined five groups but helps none, then decides to focus on one; the correct line notes they took on too many.

lines.t: We've dug all week and found only broken pottery, not a single coin or jewel.
When you put it that way, those broken pots probably tell us more about daily life than treasure would.

opts: I agree; without treasure the whole dig was pointless.
Then we should stop digging this site at once.
I wouldn't be disappointed — everyday objects often reveal far more about how people actually lived.
Only gold is ever worth finding in archaeology.
dialogue.tr: A sadece kırık çömlek bulduklarını söyler; sonra 'kırık çömlekler günlük yaşamı hazineden iyi anlatır' der. Doğru replik, gündelik nesnelerin yaşamı daha iyi anlattığını söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A laments finding only broken pottery, then admits it reveals daily life better than treasure; the correct line stresses the value of everyday objects.

paracomp.text: The eruption that buried Pompeii in AD 79 was a catastrophe for its inhabitants, yet it proved invaluable to later historians. ---- As a result, archaeologists have been able to study not only grand public buildings but also the ordinary details of daily life, from loaves of bread to election notices painted on the walls.
opts: The volcanic ash sealed the town so suddenly that it preserved an entire community almost exactly as it had been.
Most other ancient cities were gradually rebuilt and altered over many centuries.
Modern tourists now arrive at the site in their thousands every single day.
Few written accounts of the disaster have survived into the present.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra korunmuşluğun sonuçları (ekmek, duvar yazıları) gelir; doğru cevap külün kasabayı aniden mühürleyip koruduğunu söyleyerek bu sonucu hazırlar. Diğer seçenekler kül/koruma izleğini sürdürmez.
paracomp.en: After the gap come the results of preservation (bread, wall notices); the correct option explains the ash suddenly sealed the town, setting up that result. The others fail to continue the ash/preservation thread.

paracomp.text: The deep ocean was long imagined to be a lifeless desert, too dark and cold for anything to survive. ---- Strange communities of creatures cluster around volcanic vents on the sea floor, drawing energy not from sunlight but from chemicals rising out of the Earth itself.
opts: Sunlight easily reaches even the deepest parts of the sea.
Recent expeditions, however, have revealed that life flourishes even in these extreme depths.
As a result, no one has ever attempted to explore the ocean floor.
Most fish prefer to live close to warm tropical beaches.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra volkanik bacalardaki canlı örneği gelir; doğru cevap 'however' ile eski 'cansız çöl' görüşünü çürütüp derinlerde yaşamın geliştiğini söyleyerek örneği hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap comes the example of life around vents; the correct option uses 'however' to overturn the 'lifeless desert' view and introduce thriving deep-sea life.

paracomp.text: When a doctor first suggested that washing hands could prevent the spread of disease, his colleagues largely dismissed the idea. ---- Today, however, hand hygiene is recognised as one of the simplest and most effective ways to stop infections in hospitals.
opts: They immediately adopted his method in every ward of the hospital.
He had also invented several new surgical instruments.
At the time, no one understood that invisible germs could pass from one patient to another.
Most patients in those days recovered very quickly.
paracomp.tr: Boşluk, fikrin reddi ile bugünkü kabulü arasında köprüdür; doğru cevap o dönemde görünmez mikropların bilinmediğini söyleyerek reddi açıklar.
paracomp.en: The gap bridges rejection and today's acceptance; the correct option explains the rejection by noting invisible germs were then unknown.

paracomp.text: Before the invention of money, people exchanged goods directly through barter, swapping grain for tools or cloth for livestock. ---- A coin, by contrast, could be accepted by anyone and stored until it was needed, which is why money gradually replaced barter in almost every society.
opts: This system worked smoothly as long as both parties were satisfied.
Livestock were considered the most valuable of all possessions.
Many ancient coins were beautifully decorated with portraits of rulers.
The trouble was that barter only worked when each person happened to want exactly what the other offered.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'oysa parayı herkes kabul eder' karşıtlığı gelir; doğru cevap takasın yalnızca karşılıklı istek varsa işlediğini söyleyerek paranın üstünlüğünü hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap comes the contrast that a coin is accepted by anyone; the correct option sets it up by noting barter needs a double coincidence of wants.

paracomp.text: Antarctica holds about seventy per cent of the world's fresh water, locked away in a vast sheet of ice. ---- For this reason, scientists monitor the continent closely, since even a partial loss of this ice could raise sea levels enough to threaten coastal cities around the globe.
opts: If even a fraction of that ice were to melt, the effect on the oceans would be enormous.
The continent is also home to a wide variety of tropical plants.
Very few researchers have ever shown any interest in the region.
Antarctica receives more rainfall than almost anywhere else on Earth.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'bu yüzden izleniyor; deniz seviyeleri yükselebilir' gelir; doğru cevap buzun bir kısmının erimesinin etkisinin büyük olacağını söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: scientists monitor it because melting could raise sea levels; the correct option notes that even partial melting would have an enormous effect.

paracomp.text: People often blame a lack of willpower when they fail to change their behaviour. ---- Researchers suggest that designing one's surroundings carefully — keeping healthy food visible or leaving running shoes by the door — can make good habits far easier to maintain than sheer determination alone.
opts: Willpower is in fact unlimited and never runs out during the day.
Yet studies increasingly show that environment shapes our actions at least as much as personal resolve.
Most people find it very easy to break long-established routines.
Changing a habit has nothing to do with one's daily surroundings.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra çevreyi düzenlemenin iradeden etkili olduğu örneği gelir; doğru cevap çevrenin davranışı en az irade kadar biçimlendirdiğini söyleyerek bunu hazırlar. Çevreyle ilgisiz diyen seçenek örnekle çelişir.
paracomp.en: After the gap, arranging one's environment beats willpower; the correct option notes environment shapes behaviour as much as resolve. The option denying any role of surroundings contradicts the example.

paracomp.text: Each year a tree adds a new ring of growth to its trunk, and these rings can be read almost like a diary. ---- A wide ring points to a warm, wet season with plenty of growth, while a narrow one suggests a year of drought or cold.
opts: Trees of the same species always grow at exactly the same speed.
Most trees lose all their rings during the winter months.
The width of each ring records what the weather was like in that particular year.
Counting rings is the only thing scientists can learn from old wood.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'geniş halka sıcak/yağışlı, dar halka kuraklık' gelir; doğru cevap halka genişliğinin o yılki havayı kaydettiğini söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: wide ring = warm/wet, narrow = drought; the correct option states ring width records that year's weather.

paracomp.text: The rise of digital platforms has created millions of short-term, flexible jobs in what is often called the gig economy. ---- Critics, however, point out that this freedom frequently comes without the security of a steady wage, paid holidays, or protection against sudden loss of work.
opts: Traditional factories have completely disappeared as a result.
These platforms refuse to let anyone work flexible hours.
Most gig workers are guaranteed a generous pension.
Such jobs are valued by some workers for the freedom to choose their own hours.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'eleştirmenler bu özgürlüğün güvencesiz geldiğini söyler' (however) gelir; doğru cevap bazı işçilerin esnekliği özgürlük için değerli bulduğunu söyleyerek karşıtlığı hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap, critics say this freedom lacks security ('however'); the correct option sets up the contrast by noting some workers value the freedom of flexible hours.

paracomp.text: After the body fights off a particular infection, it does not simply return to its previous state. ---- Thanks to these long-lived defenders, a second encounter with the same germ is often dealt with so quickly that the person never even feels ill.
opts: Instead, it keeps a population of specialised cells that remember the invader.
The immune system forgets every infection within a few hours.
Most infections leave the body permanently weakened.
The body reacts to every germ in exactly the same way.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'bu uzun ömürlü savunucular sayesinde ikinci karşılaşma hızlı atlatılır' gelir; doğru cevap bağışıklığın istilacıyı hatırlayan hücreler tuttuğunu söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: thanks to long-lived defenders a second encounter is handled fast; the correct option notes the system keeps memory cells of the invader.

paracomp.text: For decades the location of the ancient city was known only from a few lines in old texts. ---- Using satellite images and ground surveys, a team finally identified faint patterns in the soil that matched the descriptions, and excavation soon confirmed that the long-lost settlement had been found.
opts: The city had in fact never existed outside of legend.
Recent advances in technology, however, gave researchers new tools to search for it.
Nobody had ever bothered to read those old texts.
The texts gave precise modern coordinates for the site.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'uydu görüntüleri ve yüzey araştırması ile bulundu' gelir; doğru cevap yeni teknolojinin arama araçları sağladığını söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: satellites and surveys located it; the correct option notes new technology gave researchers fresh tools to search.

paracomp.text: Electric cars produce no exhaust fumes, which makes them attractive in crowded cities suffering from poor air quality. ---- If that power is generated by burning coal, the overall benefit to the climate is far smaller than it might at first appear.
opts: Their batteries never need to be charged at all.
Electric cars are always more expensive than petrol ones.
Yet the electricity they run on still has to be produced somewhere.
Air quality in cities has nothing to do with traffic.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'o güç kömürle üretilirse iklim faydası küçülür' gelir; doğru cevap kullanılan elektriğin bir yerde üretilmesi gerektiğini söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: if that power comes from coal the climate benefit shrinks; the correct option notes the electricity must still be produced somewhere.

paracomp.text: It might seem obvious that the more people who witness an emergency, the more likely someone is to help. ---- Psychologists have found the opposite can occur: when many onlookers are present, each individual tends to assume that somebody else will take responsibility, and so no one acts at all.
opts: In practice, a large crowd always guarantees a swift rescue.
Emergencies are extremely rare in crowded public places.
People in groups are far braver than people on their own.
Surprisingly, a larger group of witnesses does not necessarily mean faster assistance.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'psikologlar tersinin olabileceğini bulmuş: herkes başkası yapar sanır' gelir; doğru cevap kalabalık tanığın daha hızlı yardım demek olmadığını söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap, psychologists find the opposite (diffusion of responsibility); the correct option notes more witnesses don't necessarily mean faster help.

paracomp.text: In the medieval period, spices such as pepper and cinnamon were worth almost their weight in gold. ---- This extraordinary value drove merchants to undertake long and dangerous journeys, and it eventually encouraged European powers to seek direct sea routes to the lands where the spices grew.
opts: Because they could only be grown in distant regions, supplies in Europe were scarce and unpredictable.
They were so common that nobody paid much attention to them.
Most cooks of the time avoided using any spices at all.
Gold, by comparison, was almost impossible to find.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'bu olağanüstü değer tüccarları uzun yolculuklara itti' gelir; doğru cevap baharatın yalnızca uzak bölgelerde yetiştiği için kıt olduğunu söyleyerek değeri açıklar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: this extraordinary value drove long voyages; the correct option explains the value by noting spices grew only in distant regions, so supply was scarce.

paracomp.text: The human gut is home to trillions of bacteria, and for a long time these were regarded mainly as a threat to be eliminated. ---- It is now clear that many of them help us digest food, produce essential vitamins, and even influence our mood, so that destroying them all would do far more harm than good.
opts: Bacteria of every kind are equally dangerous to human health.
Modern research, however, has revealed how useful these microbes can be.
The gut contains almost no bacteria in a healthy adult.
Scientists still know nothing whatever about gut bacteria.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra sindirim, vitamin, ruh hali yararları gelir; doğru cevap 'however' ile eski 'tehdit' görüşünü çürütüp araştırmanın mikropların yararını ortaya koyduğunu söyler.
paracomp.en: After the gap come benefits (digestion, vitamins, mood); the correct option uses 'however' to overturn the old 'threat' view by noting research revealed the microbes' usefulness.

paracomp.text: Each year millions of visitors travel to sites associated with disaster, war, or tragedy. ---- Supporters argue that such visits help keep painful memories alive and teach valuable lessons, while critics worry that they can turn human suffering into mere entertainment.
opts: Nobody has ever questioned the purpose of visiting these places.
These sites are usually completely empty throughout the year.
This practice has sparked a lively debate about whether it is respectful or not.
Tourism of this kind brings no money to the local area.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'destekçiler ... eleştirenler ...' tartışması gelir; doğru cevap bu uygulamanın saygılı olup olmadığına dair canlı bir tartışma başlattığını söyleyerek iki görüşü hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap come supporters vs. critics; the correct option sets up both sides by noting the practice sparked a lively debate over whether it is respectful.

paracomp.text: The plague that swept through Europe in the fourteenth century killed a vast share of the population in just a few years. ---- With so few workers left alive, those who survived could suddenly demand higher wages, and the rigid social order that had bound peasants to the land began to loosen.
opts: Yet its consequences were not limited to the terrible loss of life.
The disease had almost no effect on the way society was organised.
Most doctors of the time fully understood how the plague spread.
Trade between European cities continued exactly as before.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'işçi azalınca ücretler arttı, toplumsal düzen gevşedi' geliyor. Doğru cevap, sonuçların yalnızca ölümle sınırlı olmadığını söyleyerek bu toplumsal sonucu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap come social consequences (higher wages, loosening order); the correct option says the effects went beyond loss of life, setting that up.

paracomp.text: The ice sheet covering Antarctica is so vast that it holds most of the world's fresh water. ---- For this reason, even a small acceleration in its melting could raise sea levels enough to threaten coastal cities thousands of kilometres away.
opts: The continent is mostly covered in tropical forest.
Locked within it is enough water to change the height of every ocean on Earth.
Very few scientists have any interest in studying it.
The ice has remained completely unchanged for centuries.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'küçük bir erime hızlanması deniz seviyelerini yükseltebilir' geliyor. Doğru cevap, içinde okyanusları değiştirecek kadar su olduğunu söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: small melting could raise sea levels; the correct option notes it holds enough water to alter every ocean.

paracomp.text: Most people think of sleep simply as a way to feel less tired. ---- During the night, for example, the body produces substances that help it fight infection, which is one reason that people who sleep too little tend to catch more colds.
opts: Sleep has no connection to the immune system at all.
Tiredness is the only effect of missing a night's sleep.
In fact, sleep does far more than restore our energy.
The body shuts down completely while we sleep.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'vücut enfeksiyonla savaşan maddeler üretir' örneği geliyor. Doğru cevap, uykunun enerjiyi yenilemekten fazlasını yaptığını söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap comes an immune example; the correct option states sleep does far more than restore energy.

paracomp.text: The idea of paying every citizen a fixed sum of money, regardless of whether they work, has gained attention in recent years. ---- Critics, however, worry that such payments would be enormously expensive and might discourage some people from working at all.
opts: Nobody has ever taken this idea seriously.
Such payments would cost the government almost nothing.
Everyone agrees that the scheme would be a disaster.
Supporters argue that it would give people security and the freedom to take risks.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'eleştirmenler maliyetli ve çalışmayı caydırıcı bulur' (however) geliyor. Doğru cevap, destekçilerin güvenlik ve risk alma özgürlüğü görüşünü vererek karşıtlığı hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap critics object ('however'); the correct option gives supporters' view of security and freedom, setting up the contrast.

paracomp.text: Billions of years ago, the air on Earth contained almost no oxygen. ---- As these tiny organisms spread across the oceans, they slowly filled the atmosphere with the oxygen on which most life, including our own, now depends.
opts: The first life able to use sunlight to make food changed everything.
Oxygen has always been present in exactly the same amount.
No living thing has ever affected the atmosphere.
The oceans were completely empty of life.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'bu canlılar yayıldıkça atmosferi oksijenle doldurdu' geliyor. Doğru cevap, güneş ışığıyla besin yapan ilk yaşamın her şeyi değiştirdiğini söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: these organisms filled the air with oxygen; the correct option introduces the first photosynthetic life that changed everything.

paracomp.text: Before the printing press, books had to be copied slowly by hand, and ideas spread no faster than a person could travel. ---- Within decades of its invention, the same text could be produced in thousands of copies, allowing new and sometimes dangerous ideas to reach a vast audience almost overnight.
opts: The press made the copying of books even slower than before.
The new machine transformed the speed at which knowledge could move.
Few people ever noticed that the press existed.
Books remained as rare and expensive as they had always been.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'aynı metin binlerce kopya basılabildi, fikirler geniş kitleye ulaştı' geliyor. Doğru cevap, makinenin bilginin yayılma hızını dönüştürdüğünü söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: thousands of copies reached a vast audience; the correct option says the press transformed how fast knowledge could move.

paracomp.text: Doctors have long known that a harmless sugar pill can sometimes make patients feel better. ---- This raises a difficult question: is it acceptable to give someone a treatment that has no active ingredient, even if it might genuinely help them?
opts: The effect disappears the moment a patient is told the pill is fake.
Such pills work only because patients are clever enough to see through them.
The puzzle is that this improvement happens even though the pill does nothing chemically.
Sugar pills are known to cure every illness completely.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'etkin maddesi olmayan tedavi vermek etik mi?' sorusu geliyor. Doğru cevap, hapın kimyasal olarak hiçbir şey yapmamasına rağmen iyileşme olduğunu söyleyerek bu ikilemi hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap comes an ethical question about inert treatment; the correct option notes the improvement happens though the pill does nothing chemically.

paracomp.text: The world's oceans are not still; great rivers of water move constantly through them, carrying warmth from the equator towards the poles. ---- Without this steady flow of heat, many regions that are now mild would be far colder, and the climate of whole continents would be transformed.
opts: These currents have no effect on temperature anywhere.
The oceans are completely motionless from top to bottom.
Heat is unable to travel through water of any kind.
One of these currents keeps much of north-western Europe surprisingly warm.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'bu ısı akışı olmasa birçok ılıman bölge çok daha soğuk olurdu' geliyor. Doğru cevap, bir akıntının Kuzeybatı Avrupa'yı ılık tuttuğunu söyleyerek bu örneği hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: without this heat flow mild regions would be colder; the correct option gives the example of a current warming north-western Europe.

paracomp.text: Many people now earn money through apps that offer short, flexible jobs such as delivering food or driving passengers. ---- On the other hand, these workers often have no guaranteed hours, no paid holidays, and little protection if they suddenly lose the work.
opts: Such work offers the freedom to choose when and how much to work.
These jobs always come with full benefits and job security.
No one is interested in this kind of flexible work.
Apps have made all traditional jobs disappear.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'öte yandan güvenceli saat, ücretli izin yok' geliyor. Doğru cevap, bu işin ne zaman ve ne kadar çalışacağını seçme özgürlüğü sunduğunu söyleyerek karşıtlığı hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap come the downsides ('on the other hand'); the correct option states the freedom such work offers, setting up the contrast.

paracomp.text: A vaccine protects the person who receives it, but its benefits do not stop there. ---- When a large enough share of a community is immune, a disease struggles to spread at all, which shields even those who cannot be vaccinated, such as newborn babies.
opts: A vaccine can only ever help the single person who takes it.
The wider effect appears once most of a population is protected.
Diseases spread fastest when almost everyone is immune.
Newborn babies are the only people a vaccine protects.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'yeterli kişi bağışıksa hastalık yayılamaz, aşılanamayanlar da korunur' geliyor. Doğru cevap, çoğunluk korunduğunda geniş etkinin ortaya çıktığını söyleyerek sürü bağışıklığını hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: herd immunity shields the unvaccinated; the correct option notes the wider effect appears once most are protected.

paracomp.text: Every week, hundreds of thousands of people around the world leave the countryside and move into cities. ---- This rapid growth can overwhelm housing, transport, and water supplies, forcing city governments to build and plan faster than ever before.
opts: City populations have stayed exactly the same for decades.
People are actually leaving cities for the countryside.
As a result, cities are growing at a speed never seen in history.
Cities never face any problems as they grow.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'bu hızlı büyüme konut, ulaşım ve suyu zorluyor' geliyor. Doğru cevap, şehirlerin tarihte görülmemiş hızda büyüdüğünü söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: rapid growth strains housing and water; the correct option notes cities are growing at an unprecedented speed.

paracomp.text: The discovery of the first antibiotic is often told as a story of luck, when a scientist noticed that mould had killed the bacteria on a forgotten dish. ---- Turning that chance observation into a usable medicine, however, took many more years of patient and difficult laboratory work by a large team of researchers.
opts: The medicine was ready for patients on the very same day.
No further work was ever needed after that moment.
The mould had no effect on the bacteria at all.
Yet luck alone was only the beginning of the story.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'ama bunu ilaca dönüştürmek yıllarca laboratuvar çalışması gerektirdi' geliyor. Doğru cevap, şansın yalnızca başlangıç olduğunu söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: turning it into medicine took years of work; the correct option notes luck was only the beginning.

paracomp.text: In and around big cities, the glow of street lights makes it almost impossible to see more than a few stars. ---- Some communities have started switching to lamps that point their light downwards, so that people can once again enjoy a sky full of stars at night.
opts: This loss of the night sky is now being taken seriously.
Bright city lights actually make the stars easier to see.
No one cares whether the stars are visible or not.
Street lights have no effect on the night sky.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'bazı topluluklar ışığı aşağı yönlendiren lambalara geçti' geliyor. Doğru cevap, gece gökyüzünün kaybının ciddiye alınmaya başladığını söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: communities adopt downward lamps; the correct option states the loss of the night sky is now being taken seriously.

paracomp.text: The long routes that linked East and West are remembered above all for the trade in silk and spices. ---- Travelling alongside the merchants, however, were religions, scientific ideas, and artistic styles, which spread between civilisations that might otherwise never have met.
opts: Nothing but goods ever moved along these routes.
Their importance, though, lay in far more than the goods they carried.
The routes were used only once and then forgotten.
Merchants on these routes carried no goods at all.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'tüccarların yanında din, bilim ve sanat da yol aldı' geliyor. Doğru cevap, önemin taşınan mallardan fazlası olduğunu söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: religions and ideas travelled too; the correct option notes their importance lay in more than goods.

paracomp.text: It was once believed that the adult brain was fixed, unable to change after childhood. ---- Research now shows that even in old age the brain can form new connections, which is why people can still learn languages or recover skills after an injury.
opts: This belief has been proven completely correct.
The brain stops working entirely in adulthood.
This view has turned out to be largely mistaken.
Children's brains are the only ones that ever change.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'yaşlılıkta bile beyin yeni bağlantı kurabilir' geliyor. Doğru cevap, eski görüşün büyük ölçüde yanlış çıktığını söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: the brain forms new connections even in age; the correct option says the old view turned out to be largely mistaken.

paracomp.text: Wind and solar power are clean and increasingly cheap, but they share one awkward problem. ---- Because the wind does not always blow and the sun does not always shine, engineers must find ways to store energy for the times when neither is available.
opts: They produce a perfectly steady amount of power at all times.
They can only be built in places that are always dark.
They are far too expensive for anyone to use.
Their output is not always there exactly when it is needed.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'rüzgâr ve güneş sürekli olmadığından enerji depolanmalı' geliyor. Doğru cevap, üretimin tam gerektiğinde her zaman var olmadığını söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: storage is needed because wind/sun aren't constant; the correct option notes their output isn't always there when needed.

paracomp.text: For a long time, museums were quiet places where visitors simply looked at objects behind glass. ---- Today, many of them invite people to touch models, try experiments, and ask questions, in the belief that we learn far more by doing than by looking alone.
opts: The way museums teach has changed a great deal.
Museums have refused to change in any way.
Visitors are no longer allowed inside museums.
Objects are now always hidden from the public.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'bugün dokunmaya ve deney yapmaya davet ediyorlar' geliyor. Doğru cevap, müzelerin öğretme biçiminin büyük ölçüde değiştiğini söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: museums now invite touching and experiments; the correct option states how museums teach has changed greatly.

paracomp.text: High in the mountains, glaciers act like giant frozen reservoirs, storing water in winter and releasing it slowly through the dry summer months. ---- As these glaciers shrink, the rivers they feed may run full for a while but eventually fall, threatening the water supply of the millions of people who live downstream.
opts: Glaciers have no effect on the rivers below them.
This steady release is exactly what makes them so important.
The rivers below glaciers never carry any water.
Shrinking glaciers make rivers flow forever.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'buzullar küçüldükçe besledikleri nehirler önce dolup sonra azalır' geliyor. Doğru cevap, bu istikrarlı salımın onları çok önemli kıldığını söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: shrinking glaciers threaten downstream water; the correct option notes this steady release is what makes them so important.

paracomp.text: The earliest forms of writing were not created to record poetry or history. ---- Instead, they grew out of the practical need of merchants and officials to keep track of grain, taxes, and debts, and only later became a tool for literature.
opts: They were invented purely to write down great stories.
Writing has never had anything to do with trade.
Their origins were surprisingly ordinary and commercial.
The first writers cared only about poetry.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'tüccar ve memurların tahıl, vergi, borç takibinden doğdu' geliyor. Doğru cevap, kökenlerinin sıradan ve ticari olduğunu söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: writing arose from tracking grain and taxes; the correct option notes its origins were ordinary and commercial.

paracomp.text: When plastic waste reaches the ocean, it does not simply disappear. ---- Instead, sunlight and waves break it into ever smaller fragments, until tiny particles spread through the water and are swallowed by fish, eventually finding their way back onto our own plates.
opts: The plastic dissolves harmlessly within a few hours.
Fish are completely unable to swallow any plastic.
Ocean plastic has no effect on what we eat.
Rather, it begins a long and troubling journey through the food chain.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'güneş ve dalgalar onu küçük parçalara ayırır, balıklar yutar, tabağımıza döner' geliyor. Doğru cevap, plastiğin besin zincirinde uzun ve rahatsız edici bir yolculuğa başladığını söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: plastic fragments enter the food chain and return to our plates; the correct option says it begins a long, troubling journey through the food chain.

translate.source: The evidence suggests that human activity has played a decisive role in the recent rise in global temperatures.
opts: Kanıtlar, insan faaliyetinin son zamanlardaki küresel sıcaklık artışında belirleyici bir rol oynadığını göstermektedir.
Kanıtlara göre küresel sıcaklıklar insan faaliyetinden bağımsız olarak yükselmiştir.
İnsan faaliyetinin küresel ısınmayı durdurmada önemli bir rol oynadığı ileri sürülmektedir.
Bazı kanıtlar, sıcaklık artışının yakında duracağını ima etmektedir.
translate.tr: 'has played a decisive role in the recent rise' = son artışta belirleyici rol oynadı; doğru çeviri bunu birebir karşılar. Çeldiriciler 'bağımsız' ya da 'durdurma' diyerek anlamı çarpıtır.
translate.en: 'has played a decisive role in the recent rise' is rendered exactly by the correct translation; distractors distort it with 'independent' or 'stopping'.

translate.source: Scholars have long debated whether the manuscript was written by a single author or compiled from several earlier sources.
opts: Akademisyenler el yazmasının kim tarafından yazıldığını hiçbir zaman merak etmemiştir.
Akademisyenler el yazmasının tek bir yazar tarafından mı yazıldığını yoksa daha eski birkaç kaynaktan mı derlendiğini uzun süredir tartışmaktadır.
El yazmasının tek bir yazara ait olduğu artık kesin olarak bilinmektedir.
Akademisyenler yakın zamanda el yazmasının sahte olduğunu kanıtlamıştır.
translate.tr: 'have long debated whether ... or ...' = uzun süredir ... mı yoksa ... mı diye tartışıyor; doğru çeviri iki seçenekli tartışmayı korur. Çeldiriciler kesinlik ekler ya da konuyu değiştirir.
translate.en: 'have long debated whether ... or ...' keeps the two-option debate in the correct translation; distractors add false certainty or change the topic.

translate.source: Although the treatment appears promising, doctors warn that it should not be used widely until further trials confirm its safety.
opts: Tedavi umut verici göründüğü için doktorlar onun hemen yaygın olarak kullanılmasını önermektedir.
Doktorlar tedavinin güvenli olmadığını ve asla kullanılmaması gerektiğini söylemektedir.
Tedavi umut verici görünse de doktorlar, güvenliği başka denemelerle doğrulanana dek yaygın biçimde kullanılmaması gerektiği konusunda uyarmaktadır.
Tedavinin güvenliği zaten kanıtlandığından başka denemeye gerek yoktur.
translate.tr: 'Although ... promising ... should not be used widely until further trials confirm' = umut verici olsa da denemeler doğrulayana dek yaygın kullanılmamalı; doğru çeviri bu koşullu uyarıyı korur. Çeldiriciler çekinceyi siler.
translate.en: 'Although promising ... should not be used widely until further trials confirm' keeps the conditional caution; distractors drop the caveat.

translate.source: The government's decision to raise interest rates was intended to curb inflation, even at the risk of slowing economic growth.
opts: Hükûmet, ekonomik büyümeyi hızlandırmak için faiz oranlarını düşürmeye karar vermiştir.
Faiz oranlarındaki artış enflasyonu yükseltmek amacıyla yapılmıştır.
Hükûmet, büyümeyi yavaşlatmamak için faiz oranlarını sabit tutmaya karar verdi.
Hükûmetin faiz oranlarını artırma kararı, ekonomik büyümeyi yavaşlatma riskini göze alarak bile enflasyonu dizginlemeyi amaçlıyordu.
translate.tr: 'to curb inflation, even at the risk of slowing growth' = büyümeyi yavaşlatma riskini göze alarak enflasyonu dizginlemek; doğru çeviri bu amaç-risk dengesini korur. Çeldiriciler kararın yönünü tersine çevirir.
translate.en: 'to curb inflation, even at the risk of slowing growth' keeps the aim-risk balance; distractors reverse the decision.

translate.source: The artefacts found at the site reveal that the community traded with regions far beyond its own borders.
opts: Bölgede bulunan eserler, topluluğun kendi sınırlarının çok ötesindeki bölgelerle ticaret yaptığını ortaya koymaktadır.
Bölgede hiçbir esere rastlanmadığı için ticaret yapılıp yapılmadığı bilinmemektedir.
Topluluğun yalnızca komşu köylerle ticaret yaptığı anlaşılmıştır.
Bulunan eserler topluluğun dış dünyadan tamamen yalıtılmış olduğunu göstermektedir.
translate.tr: 'traded with regions far beyond its own borders' = kendi sınırlarının çok ötesindeki bölgelerle ticaret; doğru çeviri bunu korur. Çeldiriciler 'yalnızca komşu' ya da 'yalıtılmış' diyerek çelişir.
translate.en: 'traded with regions far beyond its own borders' is kept; distractors contradict it with 'only neighbours' or 'isolated'.

translate.source: The brain remains capable of reorganising itself throughout life, forming new connections in response to learning and experience.
opts: Beyin yalnızca çocuklukta gelişir ve yetişkinlikte hiç değişmez.
Beyin, yaşam boyunca kendini yeniden düzenleyebilme yeteneğini korur ve öğrenme ile deneyime karşılık yeni bağlantılar kurar.
Beyin, deneyimden bağımsız olarak doğuştan gelen bağlantılarını korur.
Öğrenme, beynin yeni bağlantılar kurmasını engeller.
translate.tr: 'remains capable of reorganising itself throughout life ... new connections' = yaşam boyu kendini düzenleyip yeni bağlantı kurar; doğru çeviri bunu korur. Çeldiriciler yetişkinlikte değişmez der ya da öğrenmenin engellediğini söyler.
translate.en: 'remains capable of reorganising itself throughout life ... new connections' is kept; distractors say it never changes in adulthood or that learning prevents new connections.

translate.source: As the cost of clean energy continues to fall, more and more households are choosing to install solar panels on their roofs.
opts: Temiz enerji pahalı kaldığı için çok az hane güneş paneli kurmaktadır.
Güneş panellerinin maliyeti arttıkça haneler bunlardan vazgeçmektedir.
Temiz enerjinin maliyeti düşmeye devam ettikçe gittikçe daha fazla hane, çatılarına güneş paneli kurmayı tercih ediyor.
Haneler, çatılarındaki güneş panellerini sökmeye karar vermiştir.
translate.tr: 'As the cost ... continues to fall, more and more households are choosing to install' = maliyet düştükçe daha çok hane kurmayı tercih ediyor; doğru çeviri bu neden-sonucu korur. Çeldiriciler yönü tersine çevirir.
translate.en: 'As the cost continues to fall, more households are choosing to install' keeps the cause-effect; distractors reverse it.

translate.source: Planners increasingly recognise that a city designed around cars is rarely a city designed for the people who live in it.
opts: Şehir plancıları, otomobiller için tasarlanan şehirlerin insanlar için de en uygun şehirler olduğunu savunuyor.
Plancılar, şehirlerin yalnızca otomobiller düşünülerek tasarlanması gerektiğini söylüyor.
İnsanlar için tasarlanan şehirlerin otomobillere hiç yer bırakmadığı kabul edilmektedir.
Şehir plancıları, otomobiller etrafında tasarlanmış bir şehrin, orada yaşayan insanlar için tasarlanmış bir şehir olmadığını giderek daha çok kabul ediyor.
translate.tr: 'a city designed around cars is rarely a city designed for the people' = otomobiller için tasarlanan şehir nadiren insanlar içindir; doğru çeviri bu karşıtlığı korur. Çeldiriciler anlamı tersine çevirir.
translate.en: 'a city designed around cars is rarely a city designed for the people' keeps the contrast; distractors reverse the meaning.

translate.source: Tarihçiler, imparatorluğun çöküşünün tek bir nedene değil, birbiriyle ilişkili birçok etkenin birleşimine bağlanması gerektiğini savunmaktadır.
opts: Historians argue that the empire's collapse should be attributed not to a single cause but to a combination of many interrelated factors.
Historians believe that the empire collapsed for one simple and obvious reason.
Historians claim that the empire never actually collapsed at all.
Historians suggest that the many factors behind the collapse were entirely unrelated to one another.
translate.tr: 'tek bir nedene değil ... birçok etkenin birleşimine' = not to a single cause but to a combination of many factors; doğru çeviri bunu korur. Çeldiriciler tek neden ya da 'ilişkisiz etkenler' diyerek çelişir.
translate.en: 'not to a single cause but to a combination of interrelated factors' is kept; distractors give a single cause or call the factors unrelated.

translate.source: Araştırmacılar, yeni ilacın yan etkilerinin tam olarak anlaşılabilmesi için daha uzun süreli çalışmalara ihtiyaç duyulduğunu vurgulamaktadır.
opts: Researchers claim that the side effects of the new drug are already completely understood.
Researchers emphasise that longer-term studies are needed before the side effects of the new drug can be fully understood.
Researchers argue that no further studies of the new drug are necessary.
Researchers stress that the new drug has no side effects whatsoever.
translate.tr: 'tam olarak anlaşılabilmesi için daha uzun çalışmalara ihtiyaç' = longer-term studies are needed before fully understood; doğru çeviri bunu korur. Çeldiriciler gereği siler ya da tersine çevirir.
translate.en: 'longer-term studies are needed before the side effects can be fully understood' is kept; distractors drop or reverse the need.

translate.source: Ormanların hızla yok edilmesi, yalnızca pek çok türün yaşam alanını değil, aynı zamanda bölgenin iklimini de tehdit etmektedir.
opts: The rapid destruction of forests threatens only the habitat of a few rare species.
Planting new forests has improved both wildlife and the regional climate.
The rapid destruction of forests threatens not only the habitat of many species but also the climate of the region.
The destruction of forests has no effect on the climate of the region.
translate.tr: 'yalnızca ... değil, aynı zamanda ... de' = not only ... but also ...; doğru çeviri bu çift vurguyu korur. Çeldiriciler kapsamı daraltır ya da etkiyi inkâr eder.
translate.en: 'not only ... but also ...' keeps the double emphasis; distractors narrow the scope or deny the effect.

translate.source: Yapay zekâ araçları giderek yetkinleşse de, karmaşık etik kararların hâlâ insan denetimini gerektirdiği yaygın olarak kabul edilmektedir.
opts: Because artificial intelligence tools are now fully capable, human oversight of ethical decisions is no longer needed.
Artificial intelligence tools remain too weak to be of any use in decision-making.
It is widely denied that ethical decisions have anything to do with human judgement.
Although artificial intelligence tools are becoming increasingly capable, it is widely accepted that complex ethical decisions still require human oversight.
translate.tr: 'giderek yetkinleşse de ... insan denetimini gerektirir' = although increasingly capable ... still require human oversight; doğru çeviri bu ödün yapısını korur. Çeldiriciler denetimi gereksiz sayar.
translate.en: 'although increasingly capable ... still require human oversight' keeps the concessive structure; distractors drop the needed oversight.

translate.source: İnsanların kararlarının çoğu zaman mantıktan çok duygulardan etkilendiği, son yıllarda yapılan deneylerle açıkça gösterilmiştir.
opts: Experiments carried out in recent years have clearly shown that people's decisions are often influenced more by emotion than by logic.
Recent experiments have shown that people's decisions are guided purely by cold logic.
It has never been demonstrated that emotions affect human decisions.
People's decisions are influenced more by logic than by emotion, recent studies suggest.
translate.tr: 'mantıktan çok duygulardan etkilendiği' = influenced more by emotion than by logic; doğru çeviri bu karşılaştırmayı korur. Çeldiriciler karşılaştırmayı tersine çevirir ya da inkâr eder.
translate.en: 'influenced more by emotion than by logic' keeps the comparison; distractors reverse or deny it.

translate.source: Küçük işletmeler, büyük şirketlerle rekabet edebilmek için çoğu zaman yenilikçi fikirlere ve esnek çalışma biçimlerine güvenmek zorundadır.
opts: Large companies usually rely on small businesses to provide them with innovative ideas.
In order to compete with large companies, small businesses often have to rely on innovative ideas and flexible ways of working.
Small businesses rarely need any new ideas to compete with large companies.
Small businesses prefer to avoid competing with large companies altogether.
translate.tr: 'rekabet edebilmek için ... yenilikçi fikirlere ve esnek çalışmaya güvenmek zorunda' = to compete ... have to rely on innovative ideas and flexible working; doğru çeviri bunu korur. Çeldiriciler gereği yok sayar.
translate.en: 'in order to compete ... have to rely on innovative ideas and flexible working' is kept; distractors remove the need.

translate.source: Kazılarda bulunan araç gereçler, bu toplumun düşünüldüğünden çok daha gelişmiş bir teknolojiye sahip olduğunu ortaya koymaktadır.
opts: The tools found during the excavations suggest that this society had almost no technology at all.
No tools were discovered during the excavations of this society.
The tools found during the excavations reveal that this society possessed a far more advanced technology than had been thought.
The society's technology turned out to be much simpler than researchers had expected.
translate.tr: 'düşünüldüğünden çok daha gelişmiş bir teknoloji' = a far more advanced technology than had been thought; doğru çeviri bunu korur. Çeldiriciler 'daha basit' ya da 'teknoloji yok' diyerek tersine çevirir.
translate.en: 'a far more advanced technology than had been thought' is kept; distractors reverse it with 'much simpler' or 'no technology'.

translate.source: If the data used to train an algorithm reflects past prejudice, the system is likely to repeat that prejudice in its own decisions.
opts: Bir algoritmayı eğitmek için kullanılan veriler geçmişteki ön yargıyı yansıtıyorsa, sistemin bu ön yargıyı kendi kararlarında tekrarlaması olasıdır.
Bir algoritma ön yargısız veriyle eğitilirse mutlaka adil kararlar verir.
Algoritmalar geçmiş ön yargıdan tamamen bağımsızdır.
Veriler ne olursa olsun algoritmalar her zaman tarafsız kalır.
translate.tr: 'If the data ... reflects past prejudice, the system is likely to repeat that' = veri ön yargı yansıtıyorsa sistem onu tekrarlar; doğru çeviri koşul-sonucu korur. Çeldiriciler tarafsızlık iddia eder.
translate.en: 'if the data reflects prejudice, the system repeats it' is kept; distractors claim neutrality.

translate.source: The remarkable art of the period would have been impossible without the wealthy families who paid for it.
opts: Dönemin sanatı, varlıklı ailelerin desteğine hiçbir zaman ihtiyaç duymadı.
Dönemin olağanüstü sanatı, onun bedelini ödeyen varlıklı aileler olmasaydı mümkün olamazdı.
Varlıklı aileler, dönemin sanatını engellemeye çalışmıştır.
Dönemin sanatı tamamen yoksul halk tarafından finanse edilmiştir.
translate.tr: 'would have been impossible without the wealthy families who paid for it' = bedeli ödeyen aileler olmasaydı imkânsızdı; doğru çeviri bu koşulu korur. Çeldiriciler hami rolünü reddeder.
translate.en: 'impossible without the wealthy families who paid' is kept; distractors deny the patrons' role.

translate.source: Even if all countries met their climate targets, some degree of warming would still be unavoidable in the coming decades.
opts: Ülkeler iklim hedeflerine ulaşırsa gelecekte hiç ısınma yaşanmaz.
Isınma yalnızca ülkeler hedeflerini tutturamazsa gerçekleşir.
Tüm ülkeler iklim hedeflerine ulaşsa bile, önümüzdeki on yıllarda belirli bir miktar ısınma yine de kaçınılmaz olurdu.
translate.tr: 'Even if all countries met their targets, some warming would still be unavoidable' = hedefler tutsa bile bir miktar ısınma kaçınılmaz; doğru çeviri bu ödün yapısını korur.
translate.en: 'even if targets met, some warming unavoidable' keeps the concessive structure.

translate.source: Doctors say that obesity is rarely the result of a single cause; diet, lack of exercise, and stress all play a part.
opts: Doktorlara göre obezitenin tek bir nedeni vardır: kötü beslenme.
Doktorlar, stresin obeziteyle hiçbir ilgisi olmadığını söyler.
Doktorlar, obezitenin nadiren tek bir nedenden kaynaklandığını söyler; beslenme, hareketsizlik ve stresin hepsi rol oynar.
